entities.summary: Fascist movements in Europe were the set of various fascist ideologies which were practiced by governments and political organizations in Europe during the 20th century. Fascism was born in Italy following World War I, and other fascist movements, influenced by Italian fascism, subsequently emerged across Europe. Among the political doctrines which are identified as ideological origins of fascism in Europe are the combining of a traditional national unity and revolutionary anti-democratic rhetoric which was espoused by the integral nationalist Charles Maurras and the revolutionary syndicalist Georges Sorel.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Fascist movements in Europe had a significant regional impact during the 20th century, influencing the trajectory of politics and society across the continent. The rise of fascist regimes in Italy, Germany, and other countries led to devastating consequences, including World War II and millions of deaths.
